maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from pharma brands' marketing campaigns (point-of-care messaging, audience data), not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharmaceutical companies and their agencies paying for HCP and patient marketing; government is not the final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from selling its EHR-network and audience-targeting platform to pharma; it has made only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Pharma ad budgets are campaign-based and can shift to other media or data vendors without major disruption, though EHR network access helps.
